blocked.clean-target: Native source-to-target deploy+apply cannot complete. Blocked by the plugin, not by missing work here. Welcome::activationRedirect() (src/Admin/Menu/Welcome.php:20-53) hooks activated_plugin and calls wp_safe_redirect() then exit on every activation whose guards do not fire; its guards cover network, bulk, AJAX and headers_sent, and there is no WP-CLI guard. LifecycleExecutor.php:102 calls activate_plugin() in-process because firing those hooks is the point of that class, so the call never returns, the phase never records resolution, and the next apply refuses with 'unresolved lifecycle attempt blocks a new promotion session'. Measured on a live pair: deploy reports success and the plugin does activate, but every subsequent apply refuses. Unblocking needs either an upstream WP-CLI guard in the plugin or an engine decision about surviving a plugin that exits during activation; neither is an adapter-manifest change.
